info.title: UCP Common Service
info.description:
Canonical MCP/JSON-RPC interface for UCP Common services, including Ask and Location discovery. Schema references are logical pointers - actual payload shape is determined by negotiated capabilities.

**Endpoint Resolution:** This spec defines methods only. The endpoint URL MUST be obtained from the Business's discovery profile at `/.well-known/ucp` under `services["dev.ucp.common"][transport=mcp].endpoint`. The server entry below is a placeholder for tooling compatibility.

servers.name: business
servers.description: Business-provided endpoint from UCP discovery profile

meta.description: Request metadata mapping to UCP standard headers.

ucp-agent.description: Platform agent identification. Maps to HTTP UCP-Agent header.

profile.description: URL to the Platform's UCP profile document.

idempotency-key.description: Unique key for retry safety. Maps to HTTP Idempotency-Key header.

methods.name: search_locations
methods.description: Search for physical locations using query text, explicit spatial relations, and structured filters.

methods.name: lookup_locations
methods.description: Batch lookup of physical Locations by supported identifiers, optionally refined by explicit spatial relations and structured filters. Returns matching Locations.

methods.name: ask_business
methods.description: Ask the Business about its resources, policies, and services, including questions other capabilities cannot answer. Returns a text answer with related links; pass resource identifiers to ground the question in Business resources across commerce domains, such as a product, location, cart, order, or booking.
